propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket remote requires git-remote-s3 helper >=0.3.2 with IfNoneMatch locking to prevent multiple-bundles corruption; without it, rebar must fail closed at configuration time rather than silently corrupt the store

A new _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url(remote_url) preflight guard detects S3 mode by URL scheme and raises OptionalDependencyError unconditionally, independent of strict mode, to halt push operations before corruption

The preflight is wired into three call sites reusing existing remote-URL resolution: push.py synchronous always path (line ~418), push.py async arm (before child detach), and init.py _mount_or_create_branch (after remote name resolved)

OptionalDependencyError from the S3 preflight must propagate through write_and_push (uncaught) and be re-raised in push_after_commit (not swallowed by best-effort exception handling) to prevent the corrupting unlocked push
Non-s3:// remotes (file://, GitHub-style) are unaffected; unresolvable remotes keep existing best-effort remote-not-found skip and are not misread as S3 mode
With helper absent or below 0.3.2, init and synchronous push both exit non-zero with an actionable message naming pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' and the required >=0.3.2 minimum
